title: Developing a game factory, a gamified world builder.
author: Only-Cheetah-9579
selftext:
Hey, I am creating a world of imagination.

A sandbox orchestration platform powered by Claude Code where users can develop and create worlds for each other to play directly in Discord. They can share with friends and compete on a leaderboard. Players can create a game world with episodic content with any game they can imagine within the design system of the game factory and it's world, created with babylon.js.

[https://gamefactory.space/](https://gamefactory.space/)

The single player experience allows users to create origin games and others can fork them and make new games from it to add their own ideas. Make a game as hard as you want and watch your friends finish it. Their achievements go on a leaderboard.

The multiplayer experience will allow users to create any character they can imagine and join shared episodic worlds with their friends. All on discord.

Create games for your friends and watch them play. 

Sign up to the mailing list to get notified when we launch 🚀
